Definition: from G575 and τινάσσω (to jostle); to brush off:--shake off.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to shake off. Disciples are to shake the dust from their feet against a town that will not receive them, and Paul shakes the viper off his hand into the fire and feels no harm.
TheologicalSignificance: Some things are not to be carried, they are to be shaken off and left behind.
